title: Two-Person Crew Schedule for Member Freight Pickups — Northgate Purchases & Returns
content:
Crew staffing schedule for the member pickup fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on the changed-mind freight pickup of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership (Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club, Club or Club Plus Membership).

## Two-person crew for the member pickup

When the units on the authorization are worth 1000.00 or more at the sale line's unit price, 15.00 is added; when they are worth 500.00 or more but less than 1000.00, 8.00 is added; otherwise nothing is added.

The worth is the units on the return authorization being confirmed multiplied by the unit price recorded on its sale line. The amount is added to the member pickup fee.

| Units on the authorization multiplied by the unit price (USD) | Added to the member pickup fee |
|---|---|
| 1000.00 or more | 15.00 |
| 500.00 or more, less than 1000.00 | 8.00 |
| less than 500.00 | nothing |

## Worked readings (hypothetical authorizations)

| Units | Unit price | Worth | Added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 15.00 |
| 1 | 999.99 | 999.99 | 8.00 |
| 2 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 8.00 |
| 1 | 499.99 | 499.99 | nothing |
